thread:
rachel: Sunrise Therapeutics (acct ST-77) flagged — INV-2062-720 for $32,400 is past due and their AP team says their payment vendor (PayBridge) is onboarding this week. They offered $12,000 today and want the rest over 3 months. They also asked to waive recurring late fees while plan active. ZD #47820 created.
collections-bot: [auto] invoice INV-2062-720 status=open balance=32400 last_attempt=1868990000
derek: Contract note: their SOW allows 30-day net with 1.5% monthly late fee. Waiving fees > $1k needs finance lead approval. Also need a signed payment addendum for >90-day schedules.
samir: If they can pay $12k today, propose 3 installments for remainder: (7200, 7200, 7200) and charge a $100 plan fee. That splits 12k + 21,600 across schedule. Approve conditionally if Clare signs off on fee waiver.
clare: I can approve waiving late fees while plan is active up to 6 months. Approving plan fee and putting invoice on payment_plan with collection_hold true. Approved_by=clare timestamp=1869001500 :white_check_mark:
rachel: Great. I'll send addendum to AP and request e-sign and ACH mandate. Please wait for signed doc before scheduling autopay.
samir: Internal commands to run after sign:
```
POST /internal/finance/payment_plans { "invoice":"INV-2062-720", "schedule":["2026-05-05","2026-06-05","2026-07-05"], "amounts":[7200,7200,7200], "fee":100 }
POST /internal/finance/charges/record { "invoice":"INV-2062-720", "amount":12000, "method":"manual-collection", "note":"partial payment from AP via PayBridge" }
PATCH /internal/finance/invoices/INV-2062-720 { "collection_hold": true }
```
billing-bot: [auto] provisional plan PP-2062-4 created in draft. provisional credit/waiver record queued.
rachel: AP signed addendum and uploaded to ZD #47820 at 1869001800. They confirmed PayBridge will attempt the $12k today.
collections-bot: [auto] manual payment recorded payment_id=PAY-123987 amount=12000 settled_ts=1869001875 note="partial AP payment via PayBridge"
collections-bot: [auto] applying plan PP-2062-4 and scheduling charges. next_run=2026-05-05 amount=7200
rachel: Customer requested no escalation and no service interruption. I've added note to account and will monitor. Also opening INF-2062-12 to track PayBridge onboarding and webhook mapping.
samir: Noted. If second installment fails, escalate to collections after 7 days per policy. Leaving collection_hold true until plan completes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
